mapper.select: SELECT map.basic_id FROM olap_table_field_mapping map JOIN olap_basic_pro basic ON map.basic_id = basic.id WHERE map.table_id = #{tableId} AND map.status = 1 AND basic.category = 2 AND basic.status = 2

-- 1. 物理表对应的指标 SELECT DISTINCT map.table_id AS objId, 'table' AS objType, map.basic_id AS indicatorId FROM olap_table_field_mapping map JOIN olap_basic_pro basic ON map.basic_id = basic.id WHERE map.status = 1 AND basic.category = 2 -- 指标 AND basic.status = 2
AND map.table_id IN
#{item}
AND 1 = 2
UNION
-- 2. 模型对应的指标（事实表 + 维度表） SELECT DISTINCT dm.id AS objId, 'model' AS objType, map.basic_id AS indicatorId FROM olap_data_model dm LEFT JOIN olap_data_model_dimension dmd ON dmd.model_id = dm.id JOIN olap_table_field_mapping map ON map.table_id = dm.fact_table_id OR map.table_id = dmd.dim_table_id JOIN olap_basic_pro basic ON map.basic_id = basic.id WHERE dm.status = 1 AND map.status = 1 AND basic.category = 2 AND basic.status = 2
AND dm.id IN
#{item}
AND 1 = 2
